notes.title: Halloween Spooktacular
notes.content:
From the beginning of October for 5 weeks you can play a Halloween-themed version of Clueless Crosswords, featuring a spooky soundtrack and mystery Halloween words to find.

Use the mystery Halloween words whilst playing to collect the special Halloween achievements.

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New levels and achievements
notes.content:
In this update we've added 5 new levels and some all-new mystery word achievements.

The names of the mystery word achievements give you a clue to the mystery word.  Simply use this word in any puzzle to unlock the achievement.

Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
This is a small update to address two issues.

#1 : Music automatically unmutes after the successful completion of a level.

#2 : Attempting to delete a word while a delete is in progress causes an error.

Thanks to the Steam community for helping with this ːsteamhappyː
